role: CI gate: log-call lines (debugLog, logger.*, os_log, NSLog, print, ...) must not interpolate PII/credential names, latitude/longitude, or raw RR/beat series.
toplevel: cd to repo root; sources preflight. SOURCE_ROOTS = args or Emuqu/Sources + watch app. tmp via gate_mktemp (|| exit). find|xargs awk writes every line matching LOG_CALL not carrying (or preceded by) `log-redaction-ok` to tmp; errors suppressed (`|| true`). report() greps tmp for PII_PATTERN, GEO_PATTERN, RAW_SERIES_PATTERN; any -> remediation text + exit 1; else clean with scanned count.

flags.text: Line-based: an interpolation on a continuation line of a multi-line log call is not seen; RAW_SERIES_PATTERN only matches a bare `\(rr)`-style identifier, not `\(self.rrIntervals)` or `\(session.rr)`. A missing root makes find fail silently and the gate reports clean with fewer sites.

units.does: Greps the collected log-call lines in $tmp for an extended regex; on hits prints 'FAIL: <label> interpolated into a log statement' with the lines and sets global violations=1.
